sources: https://www.ksoutdoors.gov/about-kdwp/where-we-work/state-parks/crawford (read in a browser 2026-11-06): 'The 500-acre park features six campgrounds. There are 28 primitive sites, 38 electric only sites, 25 fifty-amp/water sites, and 20 30amp/ water sites. All of the campsites have a spectacular view of the lake.'; 'The majority of the park's campsites can be reserved.'; 'Lakeview Group Use area has 10 electric sites'; 'two boat ramps, three bathhouses, courtesy docks, and a dump station'; alert: from July 13, 2026 park traffic must come from the south through Girard; 'K-7 south of K-39 to 710th will remain closed through the summer of 2027'; Areas table: Rocky Cove (reservable, 15 W/E + 15 E), Oak Point (26 primitive, 30 W/E, 9 E), Lonesome Point (1 primitive, 4 E), Osage Bluff and Cherokee Landing (1 primitive each), Lake View Group Use Area (10 E).

https://www.campitks.gov/camping/crawford-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=519118, read 2026-11-06: 'Open year round.'; 'Sites are available up to 28 day during non peak season.'; 2027 holiday minimum 3 nights (Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day); '14 days maximum consecutive stay rule : A guest may reserve and occupy a campsite for up to 14 consecutive nights within a single campground'.

campitks.gov campsiteDetails.page for every Crawford site, read 2026-11-06: Rocky Cove 103-130 (14 at 50/30/20 A with water, 14 at 30/20 A, concrete back-ins, depth 32-57 ft); Oak Point 131-139 (30/20 A, asphalt, 60-80 ft) and 140-169 (50/30/20 A with water, concrete/asphalt, 40-70 ft, seven double sites); Oak Point primitive 001-025 (asphalt shoreline pads, category 'Tent Site'); Lonesome Point 170-173 (30/20 A) + 026; South Shelter group site (50 A); no sewer anywhere; 'Proximity to Water: Within 1/4 Mile' on every site.

Esri World Imagery with the per-site coordinates (37.6405,-94.8075 at 330 m), 2026-11-06: Oak Point fills a wooded peninsula - the primitive pads 001-024 ring its shoreline at the waterline, the W/E sites 140-169 sit inland of the shore road and those primitive pads, 131-139 in the interior; Rocky Cove 103-130 is a two-column loop on the wooded east shore of the cove ~20-60 m from the water under canopy. Lonesome Point (37.6292,-94.8133) is ~1.5 km south.

values.note: About half the electric sites have 50-A service with water (Rocky Cove's odd numbers, Oak Point 140-169); the rest are 30-A electric only. No sewer hookups; one dump station.

hookups.source: campitks.gov campsiteDetails.page for parkID 519118 ('Electricity Hookup: 50/30/20', 'Water Hookup: Y', 'Sewer Hookup: -'), read 2026-11-06

values.note: 72 electric sites in Rocky Cove (28), Oak Point (39) and Lonesome Point (4), plus a group shelter site; pads 32-80 ft deep. Also 28 primitive sites (mostly asphalt shoreline pads on Oak Point) and a 10-site electric group area (Lakeview).

sites.source: campitks.gov site list and campsiteDetails.page for parkID 519118 (site numbers 103-173, 'Depth'), read 2026-11-06; KDWP park page

facilities.source: https://www.ksoutdoors.gov/about-kdwp/where-we-work/state-parks/crawford ('three bathhouses ... and a dump station'), read 2026-11-06; campitks rules mention 'shower buildings'

min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

values.note: Most sites reservable on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov); the rest first come, first served. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, 28 nights off-peak. 2027 holiday minimum 3 nights.

booking.source: https://www.campitks.gov/camping/crawford-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=519118 (bulletins; 'Sites are available up to 28 day during non peak season'), read 2026-11-06; https://www.ksoutdoors.gov/about-kdwp/where-we-work/state-parks/crawford ('The majority of the park's campsites can be reserved.')

note: KDWP park on a 150-acre CCC-built lake at the Ozark edge: campgrounds on Oak Point peninsula and the Rocky Cove shore, shoreline primitive pads, five lakefront cabins, swim beach, two boat ramps, trails, marina restaurant (weekends). Through summer 2027, reach it from the south via Girard (K-7 north of the park is closed). --Claude
